title: Hosting
subtitle: Where the site lives and how we reach it

error.load: Could not load the hosting settings.
error.callbackInvalid: Invalid callback address — it must start with http:// or https://.

region.label: Which country is the site hosted in?
region.hint: If our requests go out from the wrong server, they may never reach the site and we would see it as “down”.

provider.label: Hosting company
provider.hint: If it is not in the list, choose “Something else” and type its name.
provider.namePlaceholder: e.g. a local host in your city

egress.label: Which server should our requests go out from?
egress.hint: The default follows the country. If checks are not reaching the site, change it manually.

callback.label: Address the site should send its requests to
callback.hint: Empty means the default address. If the default address is not reachable from inside your site, enter another one here — no need to pair again.

current.title: Current callback address
current.hint: The plugin on your site picks up this address the next time it reads its settings.
